question: Can actual joint interventions greedily select a sparse typed head/module response program that reproduces the original block8H1 writer effect out of sample?

searched: greedy joint response program temporal auxiliary
prior_art_search.relation: Singleton module effects and three typed attention groups are known, but no actual greedy joint program has selected among them and the signed MLP responses.

frozen_design.population: 32 A1 and 32 A2 original Tomorrow/Earlier rows
frozen_design.selection_split: Within each A1 direction separately, alternating occurrence index goes to fit versus heldout, giving 8 rows per direction in each split; all A2 rows are transfer-only.
frozen_design.intervention: For every candidate set, add each cached writer-minus-base response at its typed head/module and run one real joint model forward; never sum singleton logits.
frozen_design.selection_objective: Forward selection minimizes mean squared rowwise error to the writer recovery on A1-fit; ties are lexical. Accept an addition only for strictly lower MSE, for at most six components.
frozen_design.evaluation: Freeze the full accepted path and report every prefix on untouched A1-heldout and all A2 rows.
frozen_design.fit: discrete greedy selection only; no fitted scalars, gradients, or model updates

predictions.pred_a_authority_capability_and_exact_ca: all hashes match, all native margins are correct, and writer effects recur within 0.03
predictions.pred_b_greedy_path_strictly_improves: at least two and at most six components are accepted, with strictly decreasing A1-fit MSE
predictions.pred_c_heldout_a1_is_nearly_complete: final A1-heldout mean is [0.85,1.15] of writer, direction fraction >=0.80, and rowwise RMSE is below the best singleton
predictions.pred_d_a2_transfer_is_nearly_complete: final A2 mean is [0.80,1.20] of writer, direction fraction >=0.80, and rowwise RMSE is below the best singleton
predictions.pred_e_price_and_split_are_exact: stratified split is 16/16, all 32 A2 rows remain transfer-only, and price is within the frozen maxima

terminal_rules.invalid: authority, capability, split, capture, coverage, or price fails
terminal_rules.screen: all predictions pass: publish the frozen sparse response program
terminal_rules.null: valid greedy path fails heldout or transfer completeness; report the exact path without threshold repair

interpretation_limits: This is a writer-conditioned response program, not yet a donor-free compiler.
Adding both upstream and downstream cached responses can double-count a transformation; actual joint scoring and the heldout objective decide whether a component belongs.
The selected components identify a compact manipulable response program, not a claim that unselected modules have zero mechanistic involvement.
